caribbean.headline: St. Maarten Faces Strong Winds, Heavy Rain
caribbean.paragraph: I see St. Maarten experiencing sustained winds of 21 kt, waves up to 5.8 ft, and 62% rain probability, with swell from the east at 8-second periods. St. Lucia will see lighter winds of 11 kt, with no significant wave growth.

mediterranean.headline: Venice Faces Moderate Winds, Heavy Rain, Calm Seas
mediterranean.paragraph: Venice is experiencing 16 kt winds, 1.9 ft waves, 75% rain probability. Dubrovnik sees 8 kt winds and low wave activity.
